src:
MOV     DX, OFFSET M1
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
MOV     BX, 1            ; handle 1, standard output
CALL    KIND
MOV     AX, 3D01h        ; open the NUL device for writing
MOV     DX, OFFSET NULN
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK
MOV     BX, AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET M2
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
CALL    KIND
MOV     AH, 3Eh          ; close it
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 3Ch          ; DOS: create TEST.TXT
XOR     CX, CX           ; CX = 0: normal attributes
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h
CALL    CHECK            ; stop if CF = 1
MOV     BX, AX           ; BX = the handle
MOV     DX, OFFSET M3
MOV     AH, 09h          ; DOS: print the string at DS:DX
INT     21h
CALL    KIND
MOV     AH, 3Eh          ; close the handle
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 41h          ; delete TEST.TXT
MOV     DX, OFFSET FNAME
INT     21h

FNAME   DB      "TEST.TXT", 0
NULN    DB      "NUL", 0
M1      DB      "standard output: $"
M2      DB      "NUL: $"
M3      DB      "TEST.TXT: $"
KIND    PROC    NEAR     ; print what handle BX is
MOV     AX, 4400h        ; DOS IOCTL 00h: get device information
INT     21h              ; DX = the information word
TEST    DL, 80h          ; bit 7: a device?
JZ      KIND2
TEST    DL, 03h          ; bits 0 and 1: console input, output
MOV     DX, OFFSET KCON  ; (MOV leaves the flags alone)
JNZ     KIND1
MOV     DX, OFFSET KDEV
KIND1:
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
RET
KIND2:
AND     DL, 3Fh          ; a file: bits 0-5 = the drive, 0 = A
ADD     DL, "A"
MOV     KDRV, DL
MOV     DX, OFFSET KFILE
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
RET
KIND    ENDP
KCON    DB      "the console", 13, 10, "$"
KDEV    DB      "a device, not the console", 13, 10, "$"
KFILE   DB      "a file on drive "
KDRV    DB      "?", 13, 10, "$"
CHECK   PROC    NEAR     ; CF = 1: print the error code in AL and exit
JNC     CHECK1
PUSH    AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET FAILMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
CALL    PHEXB
MOV     AX, 4C01h        ; exit with code 1
INT     21h
CHECK1:
RET
CHECK   ENDP
FAILMSG DB      "failed: error $"
PHEXB   PROC    NEAR     ; print AL as two hex digits
PUSH    CX
PUSH    DX
MOV     DH, AL           ; keep the byte
MOV     CL, 4
SHR     AL, CL           ; the high digit first
MOV     CX, 2
PHEXB1:
AND     AL, 0Fh
ADD     AL, "0"
CMP     AL, "9"
JBE     PHEXB2
ADD     AL, 7            ; 10..15 -> "A".."F"
PHEXB2:
MOV     DL, AL
MOV     AH, 02h          ; DOS: print DL
INT     21h
MOV     AL, DH           ; then the low digit
LOOP    PHEXB1
POP     DX
POP     CX
RET
PHEXB   ENDP
